name: gemini-tts
description: Generate read-aloud audio (text-to-speech) using Google Gemini TTS (gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview). Auto-detects single-speaker narration vs 2-person multi-speaker dialogue from the input. Supports 30 prebuilt voices, natural-language style control and audio tags, text or file input, and WAV output. Works with Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI.
